hook_line: LARGEST IPO ON RECORD: ANTHROPIC RAISES $81.3 BILLION

hook_stat.sub: Raised by Anthropic in its IPO, surpassing the $75 billion SpaceX collected at its June listing

stats.label: Opening gain — shares opened at $111.50, above the $83 IPO price
Closing price on the Nasdaq debut day, up 17% on the day
Fully diluted valuation reached at the opening price

diaspora_bullets: Anthropic is the first large frontier AI model maker to go public
Its pricing is now the public benchmark for frontier AI valuations
news_summary: Anthropic, the maker of the Claude AI chatbot, sold 980 million shares at $83 each in its Nasdaq debut, raising $81.3 billion and surpassing SpaceX's June listing as the largest IPO on record.
payoff: Anthropic's debut is now the public benchmark for frontier AI valuations, and its first-day fade is the caution attached to it.
